roles.title: Biotechnologist 1
bullets: Operated AKTA chromatography (Sartorius columns): set-up, run, and post-run verification.
Executed downstream bioprocessing (IPF, VRF, UF/DF) in GMP clean-room suites.
Maintained ALCOA+ compliant batch records and supported CAPA/deviation logging.
Spearheaded local process improvements to enhance buffer preparation efficiency.

roles.title: Scientist
bullets: Led multiple high-profile international collaborative studies for the World Health Organization (WHO).
Coordinated a vast consortium of 32 premier institutions across 24 countries for global NAT standards.
Managed end-to-end production of CE-marked IVDs (ISO 13485/GMP) in CL3 environments.
Introduced ddPCR for vaccine stability, increasing sensitivity for viral contaminants 2-fold.
Architected CL3 facility refurbishment for WNV production to SAPO4 and Schedule 5 standards.
Evaluated Roche Cobas 6800 and Liaison XL systems for high-throughput virological screening.
